name.en: SMA MVPS 5860-S4-US / 6120-S4-US medium-voltage power station (40 ft container)
name.es: Estación de potencia de media tensión SMA MVPS 5860-S4-US / 6120-S4-US (contenedor de 40 ft)

description.en: Skid/container MV power station: inverter, MV transformer (KNAN, 34.5 kV), 3-panel MV switchgear, LV section, 1500 V DC input. Preliminary datasheet, rev. 10/2025.
description.es: Estación de potencia de media tensión en contenedor: inversor, transformador de MT (KNAN, 34,5 kV), aparamenta de MT de 3 celdas, sección BT, entrada CC 1500 V. Hoja preliminar, rev. 10/2025.

typical_use: Turnkey MV skid for utility PV blocks in US standard.

ratings.note: depends on selected inverter; count not fixed

parts.name: MV oil-immersed transformer (KNAN natural ester)
parts.name_es: Transformador de MT en aceite (KNAN éster natural)
parts.geometry_hint: Rated kVA per unit to 40 C; primary/secondary kV not stated; 34.5 kV nominal AC

parts.name: MV switchgear, 3 panels (2 cable feeders with load-break, 1 transformer feeder with breaker)
parts.name_es: Aparamenta de MT, 3 celdas (2 salidas de cable con seccionador de carga, 1 de transformador con interruptor)

geometry.description: 40-foot high-cube container envelope 12192 x 2896 x 2438 mm (datasheet W x H x D) mapped to x=12192, y=2438, z=2896. Internal layout (inverter, transformer, RMU, LV panel) is not dimensioned in the source.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module long side, y along short side, z up through thickness; origin at module front-left corner; mm

certifications: IEC 62271-202 internal arc IAC A 25 kA 1 s

unverified_items: DC input voltage window not found
Transformer primary/secondary kV and per-unit kVA not stated

sources.title: MVPS 5860/6120-S4-US datasheet (preliminary, rev. 10/2025)
sources.publisher: SMA America / SMA Solar Technology AG

mechanical.cooling: KNAN (natural ester fluid, natural air) for transformer
